headline: Eiffel Tower director faces turmoil after sidelining of female staff at request of Hindu delegation
description: The exclusion of female staff members during a visit by members of an ultra-conservative Hindu religious group, sparked a strike and two investigations. Above all, the incident exposed the underlying unease within the company that runs the Iron Lady: contested management, social tensions and a lack of effective political oversight.

headline: Paris childcare worker convicted of sexually assaulting nine children
description: Michaël M. was found guilty of sexually assaulting children aged 5 to 10 from 2022 to 2024. He was sentenced to one year of house arrest with an ankle tag, a four-year suspended prison sentence and a ban on working with children.

headline: 'With the Le Pens, family always comes first': Marine Le Pen launches campaign surrounded by relatives and loyalists
description: Following the Le Pen tradition, the far-right candidate launched her fourth presidential campaign in the company of close friends and family members on Sunday. Supporters of the party's number two, Jordan Bardella, were sidelined or lost influence.

headline: Vladimir Putin, a president sealed off in a Russia under lockdown
description: 'The Putin System' (1/3). The many 'siloviki,' officers drawn from Russia's security services, have seized power and are now omnipresent among the country's elites. Within society, they have spread an atmosphere of fear and suspicion that prohibits any questioning of the Kremlin or its war in Ukraine.
